description: Canonical token values for the swiss design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: Primary actions render as red text on paper.

color.surface_inverse.note: Swiss never inverts surfaces in the JSX; the inverse pair is Ink (#000000) with Paper (#FFFFFF) text.

color.accent_foreground.note: JSX contrast table: 'Ink on Accent red 3.6:1'. Red is never a fill in Swiss (always type or a 2px bar).

color.action.note: Primary buttons are red text with no fill ('Send ->'); the action/surface text pair is declared in contrast_pairs.

color.action_foreground.note: Same as accent_foreground; red fills are forbidden, so this pair is theoretical.

color.danger.note: Swiss has one chromatic colour; danger reuses accent red #E3000B.

color.danger_foreground.note: Paper on red (4.9:1) rather than Ink (4.3:1).

color.success.note: No status hues in Swiss: status is '●' + tracked uppercase label, so success/warning/info fill with Ink and rely on the label.

color.border_input.note: Input is a 1px black top rule (JSX input.border-top 1px solid #000000).

color.focus_ring.note: JSX selection model: 'Focus outline 2px solid #000000 offset 2px'.

font.mono.note: Swiss forbids a second family; mono falls back to Inter.

motion.fast.note: JSX .snd send affordance: 'transition: opacity 0.12s' (CSS default ease). Row selection is instant ('Transition: Instant — no animation'). exit_ms 0 is derived: the JSX has no exit animations (React unmounts instantly) and Swiss elements cut.

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s ease', 6px travel, 40ms stagger. exit_ms 0 derived (cut).

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s ease', 70ms stagger (doc row: 200ms ease, 70ms stagger). Equal to moderate: Swiss keeps every entrance at one short beat. exit_ms 0 derived (cut).

motion.expressive.note: No expressive motion: 'Swiss grids are static' (JSX don't: 'Add hover colour fills or animations'). Repeats slow.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Swiss is static by grammar, so reduced motion makes every transition instant.
